findings.note: Evidence is now resolved by the engine: blank items and typed items that point at nothing (gate never run or red, missing run log, missing path, unknown commit) are refused with exit 1 and nothing written; other text is stored as 'note: ...'. `req verify [id]` runs the stored check and records 'check: exit 0 @<commit> <log>'. At size 2/3 from stage build on, `req check` fails on a line closed on a note. Not changed here: STATUS.md still says 'done with evidence' (that line is in engine/state.py, see cross_package).

A missing path with --done exits 1 and the line stays open (at project size from build on, or at any stage when the line has a stored check). `req verify` leaves a failing line open, closes a passing one with 'exit 0' evidence, and reopens a done line whose check now fails (exit 1). `req reopen <id> --reason` returns a done or dropped line to open and regenerates REQUIREMENTS.md. Run logs are stored with a content hash because the files are git-ignored. I used `req verify` (decision 2), not the analyst's `evidence --run` / `check --run`.

`req.record_request(project, text)` and `brain req intake` store the request's sentences in .brain/log/request.jsonl (once each, credentials redacted). At size 2/3 `req check` fails on a sentence of four or more content words that no line holds (up to three printed), on an empty ledger once a checkpoint item, finished item, gate or release is recorded, and when every line is dropped. A rewritten 'passes when' or check is kept in the row and printed; a done line cannot be re-tested without `req reopen`. A brand-new project with nothing recorded and no stored request still passes with an empty ledger, as the finding's acceptance requires; it starts failing once boot stores the request (lead wires that).

Done: `req check` prints each dropped line with its words and reason every time (three, then a count), fails at size 2/3 when every line is dropped, and `req reopen` exists; any ledger change regenerates STATUS.md. Remaining: STATUS.md still shows drops as a count, because that line is written in engine/state.py; `req.status_lines(project)` is ready and tested for it (one-line change, see cross_package). Not done, not in the package decisions: a NEEDS_YOU item on each drop, and the dropped count in boot's line.

Done: a line with a stored check can only be closed by `req verify` (any stage), so the analyst's own commands now exit 1; gate: evidence is accepted only for a green run by this session on the current work; url: is checked live; owner: is checked in the transcript. Two things remain true and should be known: (1) by decision 8, before stage build a note such as 'looks fine' still closes a line that has no check; `req check` then says so in its line and `brain done` refuses it. (2) STATUS.md still says 'done with evidence' until engine/state.py uses `req.status_lines` (cross_package).

`brain done [--json]` prints each requirement as verified, done but not verified or not done (worst first, at most 8 lines), one line for gates, tree and push state and drops, then DONE or NOT DONE with the first reason; exit 0 only when done; it writes nothing. It is always strict, whatever the stage. Per decision 7 it does not run the live check or read release records. Open NEEDS_YOU items are counted on the verdict line and do not block. A project with no command gate defined is not blocked on gates; the line says 'no command gate is defined'.

Only the part assigned to this package (decision 5): `req add` takes several lines in one call with repeatable --line "<words> :: <passes when> :: <check>" or --from <file> (text lines or JSON objects); one bad line adds nothing; the single --quote form is unchanged. The rest of that finding belongs to other packages.

Only the part assigned to this package (decision 6): text given to req add, set, evidence, drop and reopen is refused when common.secret_problem finds a credential (nothing written, value never printed); record_request stores it as [redacted]. The rest of that finding belongs to other packages.
Decision in the plan: later (fold evidence into checkpoint once typed evidence has proved itself). `req verify <id>` is the building block it would call.
Decision in the plan: later. Verified evidence already carries the commit (gate, check) or a content hash (run, path), which a staleness check could use.

new_commands_and_flags: brain done [--json]: one verdict from tool results (strict requirement check, gates on the current work, tree and push state, NEEDS_YOU count); at most 10 lines; exit 0 only when done

brain req verify [id] [--timeout N]: runs the stored check of one line or of every line that is not dropped (identical commands run once); exit 0 records 'check: exit 0 @<commit> <log>' and closes the line; a failure leaves it open and reopens a done line; exit 1 if any check fails
brain req reopen <id> --reason "...": puts a done or dropped line back to open and clears its evidence
brain req intake "<request>": stores the request's sentences in .brain/log/request.jsonl so `req check` can hold the ledger against them
brain req add --line "<his words> :: <passes when> :: <check>" (repeatable) and --from <file>: several lines in one call; --quote is no longer required by the parser but one of the three is

brain req evidence <id> [items] --done: items are now optional (close a line on evidence attached earlier); accepted forms are gate:<id>, run:<log>, test:<name>, a path or path:line (path:/file: prefix optional), commit:<sha>, url:<address>, owner:<quote>; other text is stored as a note
brain req set <id> --check "": removes a check (the old one is kept in check_was); set is refused on a done line

remaining:
Nothing is left inside engine/req.py. Two things outside it keep three findings from being fully closed: (1) one line in engine/state.py write_status so STATUS.md uses req.status_lines (quality2-02, redteam-08, and the status-page clause of quality-path-01); (2) boot calling req.record_request, which the lead wires (quality-path-02 only bites once a request is stored).

Choices I made where the decisions left room, each a one-line change if the lead wants otherwise:
- url: evidence with BRAIN_NO_NETWORK set is stored as a note, not as verified, because an address nobody fetched proves nothing; the refusal says the network is off.
- A line with a stored check is closed only by `req verify`, at every stage and size, not just from build on. This goes beyond decision 8 for lines that have a check; without it the analysts' own commands (e2e-trial-06, redteam-08) still closed a line on a fresh project. No existing test uses --check, so none changed.
- gate: evidence also requires that the gate ran on a clean tree, matching gate.green_at_head.
- A request sentence counts as held when ledger lines drawn from it (four fifths of the shorter side's content words shared) together carry at least half of its content words, so one sentence split into several short lines is accepted and one small piece is not.
- In `brain done`, open NEEDS_YOU items and a project with no command gate are shown but do not block; a branch that was never pushed blocks, including when the project has no remote.
- Evidence is cleared on reopen, so old proof cannot close the line again.

Known limits: evidence written before this change that happens to start with a kind prefix (for example a hand-typed 'gate:checks exit 0') counts as verified, since verified is read from the prefix; text typed through the commands can no longer take that form. path: and commit: evidence prove existence only.
